lines.say: promotes wakefulness; how it works is not known
wakefulness improves in sleepiness from narcolepsy, sleep apnea or shift work
only small effects on a few kinds of thinking tests in rested adults (small trials)
closer checks of heart rate and blood pressure may be appropriate
serious rash, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome: rare but can be life-threatening
allergic reactions: angioedema, anaphylaxis, multi-organ ones; at least one death
psychiatric symptoms; the label urges caution with past psychosis, depression or mania
misuse and dependence: a controlled substance, and prescribers watch for misuse

ask: Given my heart and mental-health history, is it safe for me?
